# Data Description
- Author: 蔡睿燊
- Date first created: 20261117
- Background: 依期中簡報（`data/temp/prelim_present.pdf`）第 6 頁與第 8 頁的定義，由 2024 年研究範圍內站點剩餘數量資料算出各站每小時的**局部庫存波谷** $b_{i,s} = \min_{\tau \in \mathcal{T}_s} I_{i,\tau}$（小時內最低可借車數）與**借車有效暴露時間** $\text{Exposure}^{+}_{i,s} = 60 - \sum_{\tau} \mathbb{1}(I_{i,\tau} = b_{i,s})$（分鐘）。有效暴露時間是後續借車需求率 $\hat\lambda_{i,s} = Y^{+}_{i,s} / \text{Exposure}^{+}_{i,s}$ 的分母；分子 $Y^{+}$（借車次數）來自交易資料，不在本檔。2026-11-20 起另加**還車端**：滿站門檻為實際運作車柱數 $C_{i,\tau}$ = 可借車數 + 可還空位，可借車數等於 $C_{i,\tau}$（即可還空位 = 0）時為滿站，**還車有效暴露時間** $\text{Exposure}^{-}_{i,s} = 60 - \sum_{\tau} \mathbb{1}(I_{i,\tau} = C_{i,\tau})$（分鐘）是還車需求率的分母；並附上每小時的實際運作車柱數與官方設置車柱數 `BikesCapacity`。每小時的狀態序列由「整點快照 + 小時內每筆更新」重建，每個狀態持續到下一筆更新，詳見[處理程式](../../code/youbike_trough_hourly.Rmd)。
- Unit of observation: 站點 × 小時（`station_id` × `datetime`），`datetime` 為該小時 [h, h + 1) 的開始時間；平衡格點，120 站 × 2024 年 8,784 小時，兩者組合唯一。
- Sample period: 2024-01-01 00:00 至 2024-12-31 23:00（小時開始時間，Asia/Taipei）。
- Known issues:
    - **波谷有缺值**：整點快照不可用時，所有波谷欄位都是 `NA`，原因記在 `trough_missing_reason`（`no record yet`、`no-data day`、`stale > 24h`），沒有補值。2025 年才啟用的 `臺大人文館`、`羅斯福路三段283巷` 全年 `in_service` = 0、波谷為 `NA`。2024-01-01 00 時沒有整點快照（每年各自處理），全部為 `NA`。
    - **有效暴露時間為 0 但站上有車**：若某站整小時車數都沒變，$b_{i,s}$ 就等於當時車數，`exposure_rent_min` = 0，$\hat\lambda$ 無法定義。這種站時多在深夜，平均約 9 輛車；是否另行處理待組員討論（簡報第 22 頁問題八）。
    - **車數有變動時也扣除停在波谷的分鐘**：依簡報定義，即使波谷是好幾輛車（例如 $b = 15$），停在 $b$ 的分鐘也不算有效暴露。本檔照定義計算，不另做調整。
    - **分鐘數依更新時間推算**：資料自 2024-01-14 起大致只在狀態改變時才記錄（同站相鄰更新間隔中位數約 2 分鐘），本檔假設兩筆更新之間狀態不變。2024-01-01 至 01-13 約每分鐘一筆。
    - **滿站以實際運作車柱數判斷，不用官方車柱數**：官方 `BikesCapacity` 常大於「可借 + 可還」（有車柱不在服務中，例如故障），若以官方車柱數判斷，許多可還空位已是 0 的狀態不會被判為滿站。`BikesCapacity` 只作對照；取當天的站點檔，沒有站點檔的日子沿用之前最近一天，當年第一個站點檔之前為 `NA`。
    - **99 的上限**：少數大站的可借車數、可還空位與官方車柱數會出現 99，看起來是兩位數上限截斷。`capped_99` = 1 的站時，`docks_*` 與 `BikesCapacity` 低估實際車柱數，`trough_bikes` 也可能被截斷；`minutes_full` 只看可還空位是否為 0，不受影響。
    - **「停止營運」未排除**：`minutes_stopped` 記錄該小時處於停止營運的分鐘數，分析時通常只用 `minutes_stopped == 0` 的站時。
    - `datetime` 為文字，與 `youbike_flow_hourly_2024.parquet` 和交易版每小時流量的格式相同，可直接以 (`station_id`, `datetime`) 合併；天氣檔的 `datetime` 描述 (t − 1 小時, t]，合併前需對齊。
- Definition for each variable:
    - 數值範圍來自下方 Summary Stats 的實際輸出。

| Field | R type | Description | Values / range |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `station_id` | character | 站點代碼（`StationUID` 去掉 `TPE`） | 120 個值，皆屬於 [stations_in_field.csv](../stations_in_field.csv) |
| `station_name` | character | 站點中文名稱 | 每站一個名稱 |
| `datetime` | character | 小時開始時間，`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`（Asia/Taipei） | 2024-01-01 00:00:00 至 2024-12-31 23:00:00，8,784 個值 |
| `in_service` | integer | 該站在該小時已啟用 = 1；啟用日 = `first_seen` 與該站當年第一筆紀錄日期中較早者 | 0／1 |
| `trough_missing_reason` | character | 整點快照不可用的原因；可用時為 `NA` | `no record yet`、`no-data day`、`stale > 24h`、`NA` |
| `BikesCapacity` | integer | 官方設置車柱數（當天或之前最近一天的站點檔）；只作對照 | 見 Summary Stats |
| `docks_start` | integer | 整點 h 的實際運作車柱數 = 可借車數 + 可還空位 | 見 Summary Stats |
| `docks_min` | integer | 該小時內實際運作車柱數的最小值 | 見 Summary Stats |
| `docks_max` | integer | 該小時內實際運作車柱數的最大值 | 見 Summary Stats |
| `capped_99` | integer | 該小時任一狀態的可借車數或可還空位為 99 時 = 1（車柱數低估） | 0／1 |
| `AvailableRentBikes_start` | integer | 整點 h 的可借車數（輛） | 0–99 |
| `trough_bikes` | integer | 局部庫存波谷 $b_{i,s}$：小時內最低可借車數（輛） | 0–98 |
| `minutes_at_trough` | double | 可借車數等於 $b_{i,s}$ 的分鐘數 | (0, 60] |
| `exposure_rent_min` | double | 借車有效暴露時間 = 60 − `minutes_at_trough`（分鐘） | [0, 60) |
| `AvailableReturnBikes_start` | integer | 整點 h 的可還空位（個） | 見 Summary Stats |
| `minutes_full` | double | 滿站（可借車數 = 實際運作車柱數，即可還空位 = 0）的分鐘數 | [0, 60] |
| `exposure_return_min` | double | 還車有效暴露時間 = 60 − `minutes_full`（分鐘） | [0, 60] |
| `n_updates` | integer | (h, h + 1) 內的狀態更新筆數 | 0–60 |
| `minutes_stopped` | double | 該小時處於「停止營運」的分鐘數 | 0–60 |

- Data path: `data/processed/youbike_trough_hourly/youbike_trough_hourly_2024.parquet` (the exact file this notebook reads)
- Source data: `data/processed/youbike_rental/youbike_rental_in_field_2024.parquet`（SHA-256 `5c91e9b4…`，文件 [youbike_rental_in_field_2024_doc.Rmd](../youbike_rental/youbike_rental_in_field_2024_doc.Rmd)）；站點清單 `data/processed/stations_in_field.csv`；官方車柱數來自 `data/raw/youbike_historical_station_raw/` 的每日站點檔（逐檔 SHA-256 記於 `data/code/youbike_station_raw_manifest.csv`）
- Processing code: `data/code/youbike_trough_hourly.Rmd`
- Role: `analysis`
- Verification status: 2026-11-17 第一版（11 欄）以乾淨 R 程序 knit 本檔通過；2026-11-20 新增車柱數與還車端 8 欄後重新產生資料並再次 knit 本檔，下方 Assertions 全部通過（結果見文末「執行結果」）。原有 11 欄與第一版逐值相同。
- SHA-256: `30e2e4381422c0b38062474c6037263c390b0b2c5ec763133ecafc81cea11760`
- Downstream analysis input: `data/processed/youbike_trough_hourly/youbike_trough_hourly_2024.parquet` (must equal Data path)

Keep these paths and the `PROJECT-PROPOSAL.md` Data Artifacts row consistent. The source
and processing links describe lineage; later finding notebooks read this exact
processed file.

讀取方式：`arrow::read_parquet()` 回傳一般 tibble，整數與浮點數型別會保留，不需另外設定欄位型別。

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "AGENTS.md")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "templates"))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) stop("Open this notebook within the student project containing AGENTS.md and templates/.")
    candidate <- parent
  }
}
PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()

project_file <- function(relative_path, area, must_exist = TRUE) {
  # Exact project-relative paths only; no first-file search or OS-root /data path.
  parts <- strsplit(relative_path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", relative_path) || ".." %in% parts ||
      grepl("<", relative_path, fixed = TRUE) ||
      !startsWith(relative_path, paste0("data/", area, "/"))) {
    stop("Replace the placeholder with an exact path inside data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, relative_path)
  if (must_exist && (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path))) stop("Input file not found: ", path)
  # Resolve existing ancestors to reject a path that leaves the project via a symlink.
  ancestor <- path
  while (!file.exists(ancestor)) ancestor <- dirname(ancestor)
  resolved <- normalizePath(ancestor, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  allowed <- normalizePath(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", area), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(allowed, paste0(PROJECT_ROOT, "/"))) {
    stop("data/", area, "/ resolves outside the project root.")
  }
  if (!identical(resolved, allowed) && !startsWith(resolved, paste0(allowed, "/"))) {
    stop("Resolved path leaves data/", area, "/: ", relative_path)
  }
  path
}

sha256_file <- function(path) {
  if (!requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Cannot verify input identity: digest is unavailable. Use an available SHA-256 implementation before loading data.")
  }
  digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
}

verify_input_sha256 <- function(path, expected) {
  # Bind this run to the exact file inspected when the notebook was prepared.
  if (!is.character(expected) || length(expected) != 1L || is.na(expected) ||
      !grepl("^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$", expected)) {
    stop("Fill the expected SHA-256 from the inspected input before loading data.")
  }
  actual <- sha256_file(path)
  if (!identical(actual, tolower(expected))) stop("Input changed: identify the new version before loading ", basename(path), ".")
  actual
}
```

## Change for Your Own Data

```{r}
DATA_YEAR <- "2024"
INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH <- "data/processed/youbike_trough_hourly/youbike_trough_hourly_2024.parquet"
input_data_file <- project_file(INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, "processed")
EXPECTED_COLUMNS <- c(
  "station_id", "station_name", "datetime", "in_service",
  "trough_missing_reason",
  "BikesCapacity", "docks_start", "docks_min", "docks_max", "capped_99",
  "AvailableRentBikes_start", "trough_bikes", "minutes_at_trough", "exposure_rent_min",
  "AvailableReturnBikes_start", "minutes_full", "exposure_return_min",
  "n_updates", "minutes_stopped"
)
EXPECTED_HOURS <- 8784L
EXPECTED_ROWS <- 120L * EXPECTED_HOURS # From the processing notebook's verified run.
EXPECTED_SHA256 <- "30e2e4381422c0b38062474c6037263c390b0b2c5ec763133ecafc81cea11760"
MISSING_REASONS <- c("no record yet", "no-data day", "stale > 24h")

# Station list used by the processing notebook, for the membership check.
STATIONS_RELATIVE_PATH <- "data/processed/stations_in_field.csv"
stations_file <- project_file(STATIONS_RELATIVE_PATH, "processed")
STATIONS_SHA256 <- "fbf0c1797ddbbe59de4852b077ce79dc8243ccc59f08caf4cff0ddfa5eba1ce4"
```

## Summary

```{r}
input_fingerprint <- verify_input_sha256(input_data_file, EXPECTED_SHA256)
df <- read_parquet(input_data_file)

stations_fingerprint <- verify_input_sha256(stations_file, STATIONS_SHA256)
stations_in_field <- read_csv(stations_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
field_station_ids <- unique(stations_in_field$StationID)

print(list(data_path = INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, rows = nrow(df),
           schema = map_chr(df, \(column) paste(class(column), collapse = "/")),
           sha256 = input_fingerprint))
```

### Summary Stats

```{r}
glimpse(df)
summary(df)
colSums(is.na(df))
```

```{r}
# Why the trough is missing (denominator: all station-hours)
df |>
  count(in_service, trough_missing_reason) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n))

# Numeric columns over usable station-hours (trough not NA)
df |>
  filter(!is.na(trough_bikes)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(
      BikesCapacity, docks_start, docks_min, docks_max, capped_99,
      AvailableRentBikes_start, trough_bikes, minutes_at_trough, exposure_rent_min,
      AvailableReturnBikes_start, minutes_full, exposure_return_min,
      n_updates, minutes_stopped
    ),
    names_to = "variable"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(value)),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = variable
  )
```

```{r}
# Hour types among usable hours with normal service all hour (minutes_stopped == 0)
df |>
  filter(!is.na(trough_bikes), minutes_stopped == 0) |>
  mutate(
    hour_type = case_when(
      exposure_rent_min > 0 ~ "exposure > 0",
      trough_bikes == 0 ~ "empty all hour",
      .default = "constant stock > 0"
    )
  ) |>
  count(hour_type) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n))

# Return-side hour types among the same station-hours
df |>
  filter(!is.na(trough_bikes), minutes_stopped == 0) |>
  mutate(
    return_hour_type = case_when(
      minutes_full == 60 ~ "full all hour",
      minutes_full > 0 ~ "full part of hour",
      .default = "never full"
    )
  ) |>
  count(return_hour_type) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n))

# Working docks against official capacity (normal service, not capped at 99)
df |>
  filter(!is.na(trough_bikes), minutes_stopped == 0, capped_99 == 0L, !is.na(BikesCapacity)) |>
  summarise(
    station_hours = n(),
    share_docks_below_capacity = mean(docks_start < BikesCapacity),
    mean_docks_out_of_service = mean(BikesCapacity - docks_start),
    share_docks_change_in_hour = mean(docks_min < docks_max)
  )

# Usable station-hours per station (lowest five)
df |>
  summarise(usable_hours = sum(!is.na(trough_bikes)), .by = c(station_id, station_name)) |>
  arrange(usable_hours) |>
  head(5)
```

### Assertions

```{r}
stopifnot(identical(names(df), EXPECTED_COLUMNS))
stopifnot(nrow(df) == EXPECTED_ROWS)

# Types preserved by Parquet
stopifnot(
  all(map_lgl(df[c("station_id", "station_name", "datetime", "trough_missing_reason")], is.character)),
  all(map_lgl(df[c(
    "in_service", "BikesCapacity", "docks_start", "docks_min", "docks_max", "capped_99",
    "AvailableRentBikes_start", "trough_bikes", "AvailableReturnBikes_start", "n_updates"
  )], is.integer)),
  all(map_lgl(df[c(
    "minutes_at_trough", "exposure_rent_min", "minutes_full", "exposure_return_min", "minutes_stopped"
  )], is.double))
)

# Balanced station x hour grid covering the whole year
hour_starts <- ymd_hms(df$datetime, tz = "Asia/Taipei")
expected_hours <- seq(
  as.POSIXct(paste0(DATA_YEAR, "-01-01 00:00:00"), tz = "Asia/Taipei"),
  by = "hour", length.out = EXPECTED_HOURS
)
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(hour_starts),
  !anyDuplicated(select(df, station_id, datetime)),
  n_distinct(df$station_id) == 120L,
  setequal(unique(df$station_id), field_station_ids),
  setequal(unique(hour_starts), expected_hours),
  all(count(df, station_id)$n == EXPECTED_HOURS),
  !anyNA(df$station_name),
  all(df$in_service %in% c(0L, 1L))
)

# Missingness and ranges set by the processing notebook
usable <- !is.na(df$trough_bikes)
stopifnot(
  all(df$trough_missing_reason %in% c(MISSING_REASONS, NA)),
  identical(usable, is.na(df$trough_missing_reason)),
  all(!is.na(df$AvailableRentBikes_start) == usable),
  all(!is.na(df$minutes_at_trough) == usable),
  all(!is.na(df$exposure_rent_min) == usable),
  all(!is.na(df$n_updates) == usable),
  all(!is.na(df$minutes_stopped) == usable),
  all(map_lgl(
    df[c("docks_start", "docks_min", "docks_max", "capped_99",
         "AvailableReturnBikes_start", "minutes_full", "exposure_return_min")],
    \(column) identical(!is.na(column), usable)
  )),
  # Stations not yet in service never have a usable snapshot.
  all(!usable[df$in_service == 0L]),
  all(df$trough_bikes[usable] >= 0),
  all(df$trough_bikes[usable] <= df$AvailableRentBikes_start[usable]),
  all(df$minutes_at_trough[usable] > 0 & df$minutes_at_trough[usable] <= 60),
  all(df$exposure_rent_min[usable] >= 0 & df$exposure_rent_min[usable] < 60),
  all(abs(df$exposure_rent_min[usable] + df$minutes_at_trough[usable] - 60) < 1e-9),
  all(df$docks_start[usable] == df$AvailableRentBikes_start[usable] + df$AvailableReturnBikes_start[usable]),
  all(df$docks_min[usable] <= df$docks_start[usable] & df$docks_start[usable] <= df$docks_max[usable]),
  all(df$capped_99[usable] %in% c(0L, 1L)),
  all(df$BikesCapacity > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(df$minutes_full[usable] >= 0 & df$minutes_full[usable] <= 60),
  all(abs(df$exposure_return_min[usable] + df$minutes_full[usable] - 60) < 1e-9),
  # A station full at the hour start is full for a positive time.
  all(df$minutes_full[usable & df$AvailableReturnBikes_start == 0L] > 0),
  all(df$n_updates[usable] >= 0),
  all(df$minutes_stopped[usable] >= 0 & df$minutes_stopped[usable] <= 60)
)

actual_sha256 <- sha256_file(input_data_file)
if (!identical(actual_sha256, input_fingerprint)) stop("File changed during documentation: inspect the new version.")
print(list(data_path = INPUT_RELATIVE_PATH, rows = nrow(df), columns = names(df),
           sha256 = actual_sha256,
           status = "configured checks passed"))
```

## 執行結果

2026-11-20 以乾淨 R 程序（`Rscript --vanilla`，`knitr::knit()` 輸出至暫存位置）執行，所有 Assertions 通過。借車端與缺值的數字與 2026-11-17 第一版相同。實際輸出摘要：

- 1,054,080 列 × 19 欄，欄位型別與上方表格一致；(`station_id`, `datetime`) 無重複；120 站 × 8,784 小時的平衡格點，站點與 `stations_in_field.csv` 完全相同。
- 波谷可用 947,646 站時（89.9%）；不可用 106,434 站時：未啟用 68,064（6.5%）、已啟用但尚無紀錄 180、跨無資料日 31,089（2.9%）、超過 24 小時未更新 7,101（0.7%）。所有波谷欄位的缺值位置與 `trough_missing_reason` 一致；未啟用的站時都沒有波谷。
- 可用站時的摘要（N = 947,646）：

  | 變數 | mean | sd | min | q25 | q50 | q75 | max |
  | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
  | `AvailableRentBikes_start` | 9.30 | 11.6 | 0 | 1 | 5 | 13 | 99 |
  | `trough_bikes` | 7.00 | 10.4 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 10 | 98 |
  | `minutes_at_trough` | 25.5 | 22.4 | 0.017 | 4.98 | 17.7 | 48.8 | 60 |
  | `exposure_rent_min` | 34.5 | 22.4 | 0 | 11.2 | 42.3 | 55.0 | 59.98 |
  | `n_updates` | 11.6 | 13.4 | 0 | 2 | 7 | 17 | 60 |
